user_decision.label: Dedicated fixed-input Explorer replacement search body

accepted_contract: fixed full-width input, fixed state line, and internally scrolling flat typed results replacing only the Explorer body
exact pre-search, loading, stale, no-results, error, duplicate, stale-selection, reveal, and source-restoration copy
deterministic focus, close, DnD interruption and explicit-reopen matrix
event-owned lifetime, static reduced-motion parity, and eight-theme mapping
Task 151 complete-body and search-only Task 158 release with DP-VQ10 and Tasks 156–157 preserved as Task 158 prerequisites
checkpoint_acceptance.serial_boundary: Task 114 is accepted; Task 115 remains unstarted and may begin only after this acceptance commit

surface.replacement: retain theme-native Explorer chrome and replace only the complete four-column body
body_order: one internally scrolling flat result list

input_and_results.result_identity: existing Node or Bit icon/color identity plus visible type, title, and full breadcrumb
input_and_results.prohibited_exposure: record ID, coordinate, hidden root, or synthetic path

stale_refresh.results: retain last successful rows, result scroll, and focus

request_failure.results: retain last successful rows when available

stale_selection.copy: That item is no longer available. Results were updated.
stale_selection.effect: keep search open and perform no path, selection, reveal, route, or focus jump

focus_and_close.result_navigation: Arrow Down and Arrow Up move one result; Enter or pointer activation revalidates before selection
focus_and_close.valid_selection: clear active/interrupted search, restore columns, reconstruct the real ancestor chain inside Inbox, and focus the actual revealed Node or Bit row
focus_and_close.stale_selection: retain query/results/scroll and return to input when the focused result disappears
focus_and_close.x_or_escape: clear active/interrupted query, results, scroll, and reveal; restore columns and focus Search Explorer
focus_and_close.route_exit: clear search and reveal under route focus ownership

dnd_interruption.effect: immediately restore ordinary columns/drop affordances and retain query/results/scroll as mounted-page interrupted state
dnd_interruption.explicit_reopen: restore interrupted state and focus the input

reveal.presentation: static non-color marker on the actual row plus a polite atomic status directly below the Explorer header

search_result_undo.placement: trailing exact Undo action inside an eligible result without replacing title, breadcrumb, duplicate text, or row activation
search_result_undo.authority_boundary: eligibility, unavailable reason, pending, failure, conflict, and semantic treatment come only from DP-VQ10 and Tasks 156–157
search_result_undo.terminal_success: retain query and scroll, remove only the undone result, and announce source restoration
search_result_undo.focus_after_success: next surviving result at the removed position, otherwise search input; never previous result
search_result_undo.event_isolation: Undo never activates reveal and never creates a drag source

lifetime_and_accessibility.request_states: pre-search follows empty query; loading/stale/error follow their owning request; error also ends on query edit, retry, clear/close, route exit, or reload
lifetime_and_accessibility.feedback_states: stale-selection and Undo-success end on query edit/new request, another status, selection, clear/close, route exit, or reload
lifetime_and_accessibility.accessibility: named search input and close action, visible Node/Bit type and result count semantics, aria-busy for loading/stale, and one announcement per changed state sentence

motion.ordinary: body swap, state change, result removal, column restoration, reveal, scroll, and focus handoff are immediate and static
motion.prohibited: fade, slide, scale, skeleton shimmer, spinner, pulse, ping, bounce, blink, flicker, and layout-transition animation
motion.reduced_motion: identical geometry, copy, controls, focus, timing, and lifetime

theme_mapping.griddo: full-width technical search field, restrained state rule, compact typed result rows, and canonical primary/action/focus roles
theme_mapping.tiny-desk: Library Index search tab, catalog-paper status slip, and stacked catalog result cards inside the Explorer body
theme_mapping.neumorphism: inset search field and state trough with shallow raised result rows inside the existing shadow family
theme_mapping.claymorphism: soft sculpted search field, shape-preserving status ribbon, and tactile typed result tiles without motion-led state
theme_mapping.origami: folded search sheet, seam-attached state strip, and cut-paper result rows with no animated fold or ghost column
theme_mapping.terminal: variable-driven command-line search, static status record, and text-led result records with no fixed JSX color, spinner, or blink
theme_mapping.retro-mac: in-pane Finder Find strip, 1-bit system status line, and hard bordered result list with no new window, dialog, or ghost pane
theme_mapping.graphite: editorial index field, strengthened-rule status caption, and restrained monochrome result rows with precise focus outline

implementation_boundary.excludes: query traversal/rank/exclusion changes, global or active-column Search, ordinary-column fallback, DP-VQ06-EXPLORER changes, DP-VQ10 state invention, product implementation in Task 114, and every Task 115 or later decision

partial_tasks.158: search-result Undo integration only; still requires DP-VQ10 and Tasks 156–157

exact_release.consumption_condition: satisfied by explicit Task 114 checkpoint acceptance on 2026-08-10
exact_release.all_other_tasks: unreleased; Task 156 ordinary-card Undo remains independently planned rather than released by DP-VQ07
